Mapbox Density

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/mapbox-density-heatmaps.Rmd
mapbox-density-heatmaps.Rmd

Map Tiles, no Token Needed

plotly.core draws density heatmaps on MapLibre tile maps with add_densitymap() and update_layout(map = go_map(...)). The built-in styles (such as "open-street-map", "carto-positron" or "carto-darkmatter") need no access token. See Map Layers for more information.

Open Street Map Tiles 

library(plotly.core)

quakes <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/earthquakes-23k.csv")

fig <- quakes |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_densitymap(
    lat = ~Latitude,
    lon = ~Longitude,
    coloraxis = "coloraxis",
    radius = 10
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    map = go_map(style = "open-street-map", center = go_map_center(lon = 180)),
    coloraxis = go_coloraxis(colorscale = "Viridis")
  )

fig

#Reference

See go_densitymap() for more information and options!
